fact: The World Bank project paper says a Cabinet Memorandum for developing and implementing the Zambia Social Registry was approved in April 2025, a concept note was endorsed by the Government in September 2025, and design of the registry architecture is ongoing, due by December 2025.

The Minister of Finance told the National Assembly the Government is developing a national social registry to streamline social protection and human capital development and to help avoid double-dipping by beneficiaries.
